name: Splitting Skimmer
description: Open with a clean diagonal cut that sets the distance and shows the opponent's guard.

name: Chimebasket
description: Hang the blade point down to turn an overhead cut away along the spine.

name: Forged Basket
description: Drive the point straight at the chest on a lunging step with the arm locked.

name: Gust Belly
description: Pivot on the lead heel to turn off the line of attack and keep the point aimed.

name: Rumbleswipe
description: Cut down onto the opponent's raised guard with qi in the edge so the blade bites into the guard arm.

name: Gust Spinecurve
description: Slip off the line of a thrust and cut the extended arm as the point passes.

name: Cleaving Granite Swipe
description: Settle the whole weight of the body behind one cut so the blade drives through the guard rather than around it.

name: Resilient Swell
description: Keep a qi edge along the blade through a long exchange so each parry also bites the striker's weapon.

name: Blaze Pipeback
description: Chop down at the shoulder with the whole back behind the blade.

name: Enduring Yelman
description: Plant the rear heel and take a heavy blow on the forte without giving ground.

name: Surging Gallop
description: Press forward in short steps to crowd the opponent and shorten his swing.

name: Rumblebasket
description: Drop the wrist at the end of the swing so the weight of the blade falls on the target.

name: Raging Falsedge
description: Send qi into the spine and let it add weight to the edge as the cut lands.

name: Mightbasket
description: Cleave on a steep slant that drives the opponent's blade low and opens the head.

name: Steadfast Knucklebow
description: Catch the recoil of a heavy cut on the forte and swing again from the same arc.

name: Swelltorment
description: Chop with the full body and a surge of qi to split a shield rim or a heavy plank in one blow.

name: Mightswell
description: Drop the saber from above the head with qi pressing down so the guard is driven low and held there.

name: Might Slantcut
description: Draw and cut while running at full pace so speed adds to the edge.

name: Annealed Yelman
description: Slide the blade along an incoming cut without breaking stride.

name: Scalding Counterguard
description: Sprint at the opponent with the point leading and the arm extended.

name: Galloppounce
description: Leap a low obstacle or fallen foe and land on the run with the blade ready.

name: Whirlthrash
description: Cut the near flank as the body runs past and leave the opponent turning in the wake.

name: Granite Backedge
description: Hook the curved edge into a fleeing leg or belt and pull to trip the runner.

name: Tiered Skimmer
description: Chain three cuts at head and flank and leg as the body runs past the opponent in a single pass.

name: Daybreak Whirl
description: Overtake a group at a run and sweep the blade across all who stand in the path.

name: Might Swipe
description: Open with a diagonal cut while a faint field of qi forms around the blade.

name: Unflinching Belly
description: Turn the blade so the thin field round it meets a cut before the steel does.

name: Wrecking Flourish
description: Thrust with the point and let the field carry the reach a hand's breadth further.

name: Knucklebow Leap
description: Step according to what the field round the body senses of the opponent's weight shift.

name: Pipeback Hauberk
description: Tilt the edge into the opponent's blade to jar the hand and spoil the next cut.

name: Needling Slantcut
description: Slash with qi reaching past the steel so the cut lands just beyond the visible edge.

name: Enduring Basket
description: Parry with the circulating field and let it bleed off a blow before the blade meets it.

name: Basketcanter
description: Step to the edge of reach and cut with the field to land on a retreating foe.

name: Backedge Plating
description: Let qi circulate round the blade as a living veil that blunts incoming edges and strengthens the next cut.

name: Rumblewhirl
description: Cut so the qi field carries the edge past the steel and strikes a foe just beyond the point.

name: Nova Gallop
description: Place the point into the seam between plates at the arm or neck.

name: Chime Falsedge
description: Turn a blow aside with the angled flat so it glances off rather than binding.

name: Glancing Flourish
description: Step inside the reach of a heavily armored foe where slow weapons cannot swing.

name: Gustbasket
description: Slash at the buckles and straps that hold plates to the body.

name: Skinning Counterguard
description: Slice into the gap at the joint and follow with a short thrust through the opening.

name: Grinding Falsedge
description: Wedge the edge under a shoulder plate and lever it to open the arm to the next cut.

name: Blaze Spinecurve
description: Draw the edge across plate with qi focused in a hair-thin line so the metal parts.

name: Intertwined Whirl
description: Strike strap then seam then joint in order so each cut opens the armor for the next.

name: Granite Flourish
description: Cut with the edge and return with the back edge along the same line in one pair of strokes.

name: Gust Swell
description: Meet two cuts in turn with the spine and the forte as a paired block.

name: Rumble Swell
description: Lunge along one line while the off hand feints along the other.

name: Gust Knucklebow
description: Pivot on the heels in a half circle to bring the blade round to the second line.

name: Belly Onslaught
description: Cut twice along the same line so the second stroke lands as the first is parried.

name: Equipoise Spinecurve
description: Slip a cut on the spine and answer with the back edge from the other side.

name: Chime Skimmer
description: Press along two tracks of cut and step so the opponent cannot answer both.

name: Tempered Counterguard
description: Cross two cuts in an X over the opponent's blade so it is pinned between them.

name: Transfixing Gallop Thrash
description: Fan the saber through two overlapping arcs that close on all foes before the saber hand.

name: Swipe Thrash
description: Cut from high guard in a falling arc like a hawk's shadow crossing the ground.

name: Immovable Basket
description: Drop low under a cut with the blade held over the head as cover.

name: Ironyelman
description: Strike with the point alone in a quick clutch at the throat or wrist.

name: Silt Whirl
description: Spring from a settled crouch to cover ground in one leap.

name: Scorching Backedge
description: Leap and slash downward at the target as a hawk drops on prey.

name: Basket Cuirass
description: Hook the blade behind the opponent's guard and tug it aside to open the line.

name: Skimmer Onslaught
description: Leap and drop the saber from above in a plunging cut with all the body and qi behind it.

name: Equipoise Pipeback
description: Spread both arms and sweep the blade in a wide arc to turn blows and cut those nearest.

name: Gustgallop
description: Draw the blade along the first track with qi following the cut through the arm.

name: Iron Slantcut
description: Return the cut along the second track as the first stroke finishes.

name: Torrent Pipeback
description: Parry along a straight line toward the opponent's centre so the blade stays on line.

name: Racing Falsedge
description: Step low and wide in a settling motion that gathers weight like water into a basin.

name: Rumble Flourish
description: Weave cut and parry along two tracks so each stroke both guards and threatens.

name: Gust Yelman
description: Parry on one track and counter on the other before the opponent resets.

name: Hour Belly
description: Run qi and body down two tracks at once so cut and guard land together in a flowing chain.

name: Unflinching Spinecurve
description: Hold a pale field of qi round the saber that shields the hand and strengthens each cut.

name: Blazeswell
description: Cut in a long curve like a river bend that arrives at the target from the side.

name: Might Gallop
description: Slide across the line of attack with a low even step as if wading a ford.

name: Murkbelly
description: Let a cut run along the blade like water along a bank and carry it away.

name: Iron Knucklebow
description: Prick at the hand or wrist with the point in a thin quick strike.

name: Sanguine Yelman
description: Cut past the guard and return along the same curve before the opponent can close.

name: Annealed Counterguard
description: Turn the blade in a small eddy that spins the opponent's weapon off its line.

name: Hoarfrost Knucklebow
description: Hold a settled low guard that gathers each blow and lets it dissipate against the blade.

name: Gust Swipe
description: Send a surge of qi through a wide cut that rolls over the guard like a swollen river.

name: Torrent Falsedge
description: Let a blow flow along the blade then return it in a counter cut that carries the opponent's own force.

name: Tempered Backedge
description: Cut with the wind at the back so the draw is helped along the line of the blade.

name: Staunch Backedge
description: Stand firm in the sworn stance with the blade held across the heart as a guard.

name: Swell Barrage
description: Thrust along a bearing taken on the opponent's chest and held steady to the end.

name: Granite Whirl
description: Take long level strides on open ground to keep the blade at a steady height.

name: Careening Counterguard
description: Slip aside as a gust slips round a stone and cut as the body turns.

name: Belly Fastness
description: Hold the sworn line and parry so the opponent's blade is driven off the bearing.

name: Rumbleyelman
description: Draw the saber in a single gale of motion with qi streaming along the edge.

name: Equipoise Swell
description: Turn the blade like a vane to the side the blow comes from and cut as it passes.

name: Harrowing Yelman
description: Cut in a long flat arc that sweeps the ground at the edge of the plateau.

name: Aegis Basket
description: Hold the blade wide and angled to cover the body on level open ground.

name: Glintbasket
description: Thrust low along the ground to catch a foe standing near a drop.

name: Silt Pipeback
description: Stride long on a held bearing across the open ground to meet the foe.

name: Slantcut Plating
description: Check the opponent's step with the blade low so they must stop at the rim.

name: Rumblebelly
description: Slide along the rim with the blade low and cut up as the foe turns.

name: Murk Knucklebow
description: Parry upward in the manner of an updraft so the cut is thrown above the head.

name: Mayhembelly
description: Sweep the blade wide across open ground to cut those around the saber hand.

name: Transfixing Slantcut
description: Drop from a height onto a foe with the saber falling first and the qi following the edge.

name: Charter Yelman
description: Hold a guard that shows no shape and makes the opponent's cuts miss their mark.

name: Ironswell
description: Draw the blade openly and cut from the same movement with nothing hidden.

name: Thornbasket
description: Hold the blade in the sworn guard with the point to the front and never turn it aside.

name: Lambasting Whirl
description: Drive the point straight in with no feint and the whole body behind it.

name: Torrent Swipe
description: Take an open stride toward the foe on a bearing held without wavering.

name: Bellythrash
description: Slash with qi held steady in the blade through the whole cut and recovery.

name: Yelmanhauberk
description: Parry in the open with the blade wide so the blow spends itself and the hand is jarred.

name: Blazebelly
description: Surge qi into the blade at the moment of the cut so the edge strikes harder than the arm alone.

name: Intentswell
description: Cut then thrust then cut again in an open unbroken chain that never hides the blade.

name: Harrowing Flourish
description: Take a bearing on the target and cut along it with the wind at the back.

name: Thorn Pipeback
description: Hold the bearing against a push and keep the blade square to the line.

name: Tempered Spinecurve
description: Thrust down the line of the gale with the body leaning into the wind.

name: Swellcanter
description: Step in time with the gusts so the weight shifts as the wind pushes.

name: Lambasting Spinecurve
description: Slide with the wind and cut as the gust peaks to add its push to the stroke.

name: Torrent Backedge
description: Parry across the line like a crosswind that sends the cut off to one side.

name: Blaze Skimmer
description: Press forward into the foe like a headwind so each step steals the opponent's room.

name: Swipetorment
description: Cut along a held bearing with a sweeping gale of qi that hits all in line.

name: Swellcloak
description: Turn the edge into the wind of an incoming cut and answer with a counter on the same line.
